# Northeastern event contacts
Researched 2026-11-15.
- 49 organizations mapped, including one optional research-institute category.
- 641 named people in 672 person–organization records (staff, faculty and advisors removed).
- 588 distinct selected person email addresses.
- 53 people have no selected address.

Published teams and accessible Northeastern officer rosters, researched November 15, 2026. Full general-membership lists were not available. Older and undated sources are labeled; ambiguous or malformed emails are held for review.
## Files
- contacts.csv: every captured person and role, with evidence.
- emails.csv: deduplicated selected email list.
- published-and-portal-contacts.csv: direct publication/portal evidence, excluding provisional name-only matches.
- unresolved.csv: missing or ambiguous records; candidate counts are retained; ambiguous alternatives are not selected addresses.
- organizations.csv: topics, speaker fit, group mailboxes and roster gaps.
- group-mailboxes.csv: shared organization inboxes.
- current-published-contacts.csv: directly published or portal contacts with a current/live listing.
- speaker-shortlist.csv: suggested first organizations based on the two described speakers.
- historical-and-unconfirmed.csv: older source terms requiring confirmation.
- clay-checks.csv: relevant Clay results and identity holds.
- northeastern-event-contacts.xlsx: these tables as filtered workbook sheets.
- data.json: structured data with all captured source links.
- dashboard.html: downloadable searchable dashboard; contains the dataset, so share deliberately.
## Method and limitations
- Engage: 32 relevant organization pages checked; 145 authenticated officer records captured. Officer lists are not full club membership. No clubs were joined and no messages were sent.

- Public research: complete displayed team sections were captured where available, including Forge product teams, Sandbox project teams, NUImpact, PEVC and WISE. Unnamed contributors, private membership and closed rosters remain unavailable.

- Directory matching: exact full names (and explicitly corroborated aliases) only. A unique name match is provisional identity evidence, not proof of club association or mailbox delivery. Multiple matching identities are left unresolved.

- Clay: a coordinated 21-person pilot/follow-up used 34 provider actions and 6.0 existing credits. Relevant accepted checks are labeled in this dataset. A deliverable address for Chen Zhou was rejected as a match for Cindy Zhou. A separate six-person follow-up used 2.5 credits and added no accepted emails; the remaining 12 scoped targets were not run after poor yield. Luke Miller’s provider candidate was rejected because the directory identifies Lindsey Chorney. No top-ups or outreach.

- Freshness: Fall 2026 is explicit for AINU, WISE and Bull & Bear. Forge product-team term is inferred from f26 source asset paths. PEVC retains November 2025 context; HAN bios retain summer-2026-forward wording. Mosaic and old Skunkworks records remain visibly historical.

- Email source errors: malformed Sandbox/IDEA addresses are preserved in published_email and notes, excluded from email unless independently resolved. Meksha Patel has a visible/mailto spelling conflict and is flagged.

- Scope is student officers and named student team contributors. Faculty, staff and advisors (including the Institute for Cognitive and Brain Health researcher roster) were removed on 2026-11-15; see the "Removed (staff-faculty)" sheet.

- The downloadable CSV/XLSX includes evidence links, status, dates, historical flags, unresolved identities and a deduplicated email list. Institutional publications and directory listings are not SMTP tests.
## Email confidence

Engage officer email: the authenticated portal links the name, role and mailbox. Published email: a primary club, university, professional profile or research page displays the address. Northeastern directory (name match): one exact name matched, but that alone does not prove that the mailbox belongs to this club member. Published cross-roster (name match): the address appears for the same full name on another roster; association may need confirmation. Ambiguous records are held without a selected email.

No addresses were invented from naming conventions. Source typos are preserved in published_email and notes. Clay validity is a point-in-time provider result, not guaranteed delivery or identity ownership. No event invitations or other outreach were sent.
Sources and observed dates are attached to each record. Primary source wording about currentness is retained. Live pages without a semester are not claimed as confirmed Fall 2026 membership.
